purpose: Reusable construction for a standing three-quarter guitarist with the existing proportions and contact geometry. Appearance is independent of the provisional illustration style.
landmark_note: These are rig coordinates, not automatically detected anatomical features. Measure attachment compatibility in the editable; feet_origin is the rig origin, not either shoe center. strum_pin_guide lies on the zero-deformation y boundary.
geometry_policy: Reskin or redraw the same registered parts. Keep attachment zones, shared canvas, hand/instrument contact and offsets. An overall scaled instance is possible; changed limb proportions or contact geometry need an adapted family, not independently stretched pieces.
construction_prompt: Use the assembled neutral construction reference to preserve pose, body scale and instrument contact. Begin with the supplied registered layer files in the editor. Apply the new identity/clothing as local edits or redraws on those layers. Keep sleeve attachment, strum elbow, hip pivot and fretting-hand/neck contact aligned. Preserve canvas and layer origins. Static hair/clothing silhouettes may change if they do not expose seams or collide with the instrument. Reuse the guitar geometry for a guitar skin; a differently shaped instrument must preserve grip contacts or receive its own contract. The raw fretting arm and fingers receive the same runtime offset; do not bake that offset into their PNGs. Validate all three grips and both strum extremes. Produce a new assembly for review, not seven independently generated body parts.
